Title: Expansion of the public preview of on-demand disk bursting for Premium SSD to more regions

Body.Content:
In March, we announced the preview of on-demand disk bursting on Premium SSDs P30 and greater (larger than 512 GiB). While you can only burst if you have credits available with credit-based disk bursting, our new on-demand bursting capability allows you to burst performance up to 6X (up to 30,000 IOPS and 1,000 MB/s of throughput) of the provisioned amount whenever needed. We have now expanded the preview of on-demand disk bursting to all production regions. You can enable on-demand bursting on existing or new disks following instructions here.

Learn more.

Watch the deep dive video.
